he.text: תָּשֵׁב אֱנוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּא וַתֹּאמֶר שׁוּבוּ בְנֵי־אָדָם׃ שׁוּבוּ שׁוּבוּ אָמַרְתָּ לָנוּ וְעַל־הַתְּשׁוּבָה מֵרֹאשׁ הִבְטַחְתָּנוּ׃ שׁוּבָה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־יְיָ־אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי כָשַׁלְתָּ בַּעֲוֹנֶךָ׃ דִּרְשׁוּ יְיָ בְּהִמָּצְאוֹ קְרָאוּהוּ בִּהְיוֹתוֹ קָרוֹב׃ רַחֲמֶיךָ

en.text: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men. Return ye, return, thou hast said to us, and from the beginning thou hast assured us of the value of repentance. O Israel, return unto the Lord thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity. Seek ye the Lord while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near. Thy mercy is great, O
